description: A gray plastic tub with small clear ice cubes sits on the bed next to a yellow cup and a purple scoop. The right hand lifts the purple scoop and dips it into the tub to collect ice, while the left hand steadies the tub; then the left hand brings the yellow cup under the scoop as the right hand tilts the scoop to dump several ice cubes into the cup, before setting the scoop back down to the right.
